name: proofbricks-xylem
description: Public ProofBricks/Xylem package for inspecting checked Lean proof graphs, rendering captured statements, and following source-backed explanations; see RELEASE-SCOPE.md and NOTICE.md for evidence and license boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect one supplied Lean component and follow its evidence.
interface.longDescription: A public ProofBricks/Xylem package for read-only graph navigation, captured-statement rendering, and source-backed explanation over selected Lean inputs. It includes the canonical runtime, compact examples, and scoped provenance records; regeneration still requires caller-supplied authorized inputs. Read RELEASE-SCOPE.md and NOTICE.md before relying on or redistributing any result.
defaultPrompt: Build the tiny configured graph before starting the canonical Xylem MCP.
Use canonical BrickConverter render-statement with exact Lean fallback for tree-free captures.
Use the supplied CompactBounds example and ask for one explained component.
